text: Mowgli went on with his work, but it was nearly twilight before he and the wolves had drawn the great gay skin clear of the body. “Now we must hide this and take the buffaloes home! Help me to herd them, Akela.” The herd rounded up in the misty twilight, and when they got near the village Mowgli saw lights, and heard the conches and bells in the temple blowing and banging. Half the village seemed to be waiting for him by the gate. “That is because I have killed Shere Khan,” he said to himself.
